title: Automation Anywhere bot fails with 'Object not found' error on invoice processing screen
description: The invoice data extraction bot that processes incoming invoices from the ERP inbox has been failing since yesterday with the error 'Object not found for window: Invoice Entry Form'. The bot was working without issues for 3 months. A Windows update was pushed to all workstations last night.

worklogs.description: Ran bot in debug mode. The bot is looking for the Invoice Entry Form window by its exact title. After the Windows update, the window title changed from 'Invoice Entry Form - Accounting Suite 8.2' to 'Invoice Entry Form - Accounting Suite 8.3'.
Identified 4 places in the bot where the window title is used as a hard-coded string. Will update to use partial match or wildcard.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Hello, I ran the bot in debug mode and identified the failure point. The bot uses an exact window title match to find the Invoice Entry Form. The Accounting Suite software was updated from version 8.2 to 8.3 as part of last night's Windows patch deployment, and the application version number in the window title changed. The bot is looking for 'Invoice Entry Form - Accounting Suite 8.2' but finds 'Invoice Entry Form - Accounting Suite 8.3'. I need to update the bot to use partial title...

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Please make the fix. While you are in there, can you check if there are other places in the bot that might have similar hardcoded version numbers?

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Good call. I reviewed the entire bot and found 4 places where the Accounting Suite window title was hardcoded with the version number. Updating all 4 to use partial matching. I will test the full bot run after the changes.
